claims: Every family template validates: ranges, conventions entries, response types, payload classes, tolerance classes and rubric weights.
A scratch template with an out-of-range parameter fails validation by family and parameter name.
The required types Q02, Q04, Q10, Q11, Q12, Q13 and Q15 are covered and their families are named in the template validation record.
Identical seeds yield byte-identical instances, and the Python and the JavaScript twins agree byte for byte on all 112 instances.
All 112 instances validate against the N04 schema with zero violations.
Every numeric key value was recomputed through the N17 quantity engine or the N18 criterion discipline, and the recompute is recorded per instance.
The review workflow gate passes, and an unreviewed scratch instance refuses the build by id.
The leak scan finds no unexempted leak; every exemption carries an N12 reason code, a Latvian reason and an explicit scope.
The grading alignment is graded through the owning engine for every payload class.
The runtime loader rejects a tampered island by digest mismatch and a missing digest by name.
The ephemeral retry path is deterministic, excludes the frozen seeds and never persists.
The frozen and the ephemeral instance are graded through identical engine code and yield the same verdict class.
The in-file smoke vector runs against the built artifact and asserts the grading verdict of a fixed bank instance.

budgets.basis: Section 1.3 runtime JS budget, ceiling re-set on the measured requirement by AGENTS.md (was 225,280 B; the N20 requirement is 225,192 B measured)
budgets.name: runtime_js_code

budgets.basis: Section 1.3 CSS range; the enforced value is the ceiling. The measured CSS is below the plan target, which is prior-phase content and is recorded, not changed, by N20.
budgets.name: css

notes: The bank island is the runtime projection of the frozen bank; the per-instance audit tables (draws, derived, review workflow) stay in data/bank/*.json and in the N20 evidence records.
The CSS measurement is below the Section 1.3 target range; that content belongs to earlier phases and N20 records the measurement instead of changing it.

ephemeral_contract.exclusion_rule: A retry seed that is already a frozen seed is skipped; the attempt counter advances until an unused seed is found.
ephemeral_contract.identity: The ephemeral instance carries its own question id (-EPH-{attempt}) so that it cannot be confused with the frozen instance.
ephemeral_contract.persistence: never persisted; the instance lives in the in-memory session only.

artifacts.evidence/N20_CORPUS_RECORD.json: The extended corpus: four gates, the runtime harness, the byte accounting and the handoff. Byte-identical across two runs.
artifacts.evidence/N20_DETERMINISM_RECORD.json: The determinism proof: 112/112 byte-identical on a repeated instantiation and 112/112 equal to the frozen bank instance.
artifacts.evidence/N20_LEAK_SCAN_RECORD.json: The N12 leak scan over all 112 instances, the reasoned exemptions and the borderline-significance cases.
artifacts.evidence/N20_RECOMPUTE_RECORD.json: The N17 recompute table: every derived value recomputed through the N17 quantity engine with its engine path.
artifacts.evidence/N20_REVIEW_WORKFLOW.json: The review workflow: 112 instances in the accepted state, five mechanical checks each, the named checks and the sign-off.
artifacts.evidence/N20_RUNTIME_RECORD.json: The runtime harness: cross-language parity, determinism, the ephemeral path, the parity fixture, the tamper fixture and the in-file smoke vector against the built artifact.
artifacts.evidence/N20_SEED_TABLE.json: The per-instance seed table: family, variant, seed key, seed and the derived-values record.
artifacts.evidence/N20_TEMPLATE_VALIDATION.json: The per-family validation table: ranges, conventions entries, types, payload classes, tolerance classes and rubric weights.
artifacts.evidence/N20_VALIDATION_RECORD.json: The gate-level summary: each gate, its status, its command and its findings.
artifacts.evidence/N20_VERIFICATION_RECORD.md: The narrative record of the same evidence, with the reasoning behind the design choices.

evidence_index.note: Every N20 evidence artifact and what it holds. The gate-level summary is the validation record; the per-instance detail lives in the records it points at.

projection.reason: The drawn values, the derived values and the review workflow record are the audit trail. They stay in the frozen bank files and in the N20 evidence records; the artifact embeds the runtime projection so that the Section 1.3 budget (700–1400 KiB total) holds.

frozen_bank.review_gate: N20 bank_review (order 16): every instance must be in the accepted review state; the gate refuses the build otherwise.

not_claimed: No official examination, grade or proctoring status.
No browser render, screen-reader, print or instructor acceptance: the accessibility review is a mechanical structural check, and the renderer-level acceptance is deferred to N22/N34.
No keyword matching as semantic grading: the N12 scanner is a token and unit-normalised rule, not a semantic grader.
No claim that the four variants are four finished questions: they are four parameterisations of one family template.

official_programme_facts.note: The 2025 programme fixes no point weight, no question count, no pass mark, no allowed aid and no exact exam question type.

policy_label: PROPOSED training policy (N20): 28 families x 4 variants = 112 instances, point weights and minute budgets are proposals. Official programme facts: seven topics, a written-on-paper examination and a maximum of 180 minutes.
